identity.name: example
identity.lineage: fresh install to the astrid identity

disks.note: LVM leaves volume-group headroom — record it, never assume full-disk

eth0.ipv4: none (example box is v6-only on this LAN)
eth0.note: record the intended answer, not the guess

wlan0.note: the box's IPv4 path — where it comes from is facts, not intent

exposure.bind: mgmt LAN + tailnet only — public ssh closed

astrid.target.contract: target enabled at boot; unit restarts only, never target restart

astrid-reconcile.cadence: hourly, persistent (root) — runs tools/reconcile.py; drift transition → operator alert; silent otherwise

astrid-ship.cadence: daily 05:00 UTC, persistent — tools/ship.py to the warehouse; failure → operator alert

secrets.principle: keys live at the operator; the box stores the minimum
secrets.on_box: /etc/netplan/<your-netplan>.yaml (0600) — wifi psk, unavoidable OS credential; /etc/astrid/alert.token (0600) — operator alert lane, sends only; /etc/astrid/warehouse_key (0600 root) — forced-command push key.

backups.payload: /var/backups/astrid/{home,etc}-YYYY-MM-DD.tar.gz — operator home (large model weights excluded: sha-pinned, re-provisionable, shas pinned in this charter), gzip -t verified, keep-last-7.
backups.off_box: astrid-ship.timer (daily) → tools/ship.py over a forced-command key to the warehouse host (stdin pipes, sha256 verified on the receive side, receiver keeps 29 files, manifest.log as proof); /var/lib/astrid/ship-state.json — the reconcile checks its age (freshness invariant).

stem.model_primary: a small instruct model, Q4_K_M — sha256 pinned in the file; coexists with in-face ASR inside 3.5 GB RAM
stem.models_dir: /var/lib/astrid-models (weights are system artifacts, not home files)
stem.offline_proof: grammar-governed drift_report emitted with zero routes (unshare -n): schema-valid JSON, applies_without_gate pinned false by the decode-time grammar, invariant-violating request rejected with needs_human=true.

brain.face: perception in-browser: voice report → whisper-tiny.q8 WASM → transcript → stem grammar-governed drift_report, with the box's internet fully cut
brain.architect: deliberation tier — pluggable, not provisioned on this box (a charter field, not hardware)

invariants: no container runtime on this machine
backup archives verify (gzip -t) and keep-7 holds
off-box warehouse shipment fresh within 48h (ship-state manifest)
